_doc: Canonical selection policy, shared by transpilation, gates, source inventory and seed provenance. Namespace matching uses the longest case-insensitive prefix on a dot boundary; ties exclude, no match excludes. Local ERP/API helpers in Microsoft.Integration.Graph are not the Microsoft cloud Graph client and remain required. Other legacy re-inclusions preserve current core dependency reachability, not permission to implement excluded Microsoft services. Licensing and Microsoft cloud integration retirement needs explicit source/dependency classification (board 0725); namespace omissions remain coverage gaps unless approved. Never equate a Microsoft name or Scope=Cloud with an external-service dependency.
_area_doc: Namespace-less files use their top-level folder within the configured app. Local Graph/API data helpers and their UT stay required. Existing area omissions remain visible coverage gaps, not automatic product exclusions.
_product_doc: Explicit approved source exclusions, reason:path relative to BCApps/src; system-symbols/ selects the original System package source domain. A trailing slash selects a bounded module directory, otherwise a single exact file. No filename/namespace heuristic. Raw object and method identities always remain inventoried. Exclude commercial license/trial state and Microsoft service implementations, not generic notifications, users, permissions or ERP workflows.
